name: Subsets of {1, ..., 100} in which at most one sum is repeated
description: construct() -> distinct integers in 1..100 such that at most one integer has more than one representation a + b with a <= b in the set. Maximize the size; the optimum is 16. For N = 100 the maximum is 16, so the task recovers an extremal set.
